Mature oak tree with irregular open branch structure, small olive green leaves with muted warm highlights and dark fissured bark. Preserve the input tree silhouette and palette. Matte hand-painted medieval game asset, no flat backdrop or pedestal.

Low irregular dense berry bush, olive green leaves, a few tiny red berries and tiny white flowers. Match the input reference. Matte hand-painted medieval village vegetation. Full three dimensional volume, no ground plane or planter.

Compact rustic split oak firewood stack. Muted weathered brown bark, tan cut ends, irregular logs on two wooden bearers, sparse moss. Preserve input materials. Matte hand-painted game prop. No ground plane or pedestal.
